The 10 AI crawlers Citehound tracks:

GPTBot (OpenAI)
  OpenAI’s crawler for training GPT models. Allowing it means your pages can shape what ChatGPT knows.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

ChatGPT-User (OpenAI)
  Used when ChatGPT browses live to answer a question. Allowing it means ChatGPT can read and cite your page in real time.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

OAI-SearchBot (OpenAI)
  Powers ChatGPT’s search feature. Allowing it means your pages can surface in ChatGPT search results.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

ClaudeBot (Anthropic)
  Anthropic’s crawler for training Claude models. Allowing it means your pages can shape what Claude knows.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

anthropic-ai (Anthropic)
  An older Anthropic user agent, same purpose as ClaudeBot. Allowing it covers legacy Anthropic crawler requests.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

PerplexityBot (Perplexity)
  Perplexity’s indexing crawler. Allowing it means your content can be cited in Perplexity’s answers.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

Perplexity-User (Perplexity)
  Used when Perplexity fetches a page live to answer a question. Allowing it means Perplexity can read your page in real time.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

Google-Extended (Google)
  Controls AI training access separate from Search indexing. Allowing it means Google can use your content to train Gemini and other AI features.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

CCBot (Common Crawl)
  Common Crawl’s crawler, whose public dataset trains many AI models. Allowing it means your content may train models beyond any single company.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Allow.

Bytespider (ByteDance)
  ByteDance’s crawler, used to gather AI training data. Many site owners block it over aggressive crawling behavior.
  This project’s robots.txt generator defaults it to: Disallow.
